tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la gnang ba'i 'pho chos mtshams sbyor dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༈ /byams mgon gnyis pa rong ston chos kyi rje// thugs kyi sras po nam mkha' dpal bzang po// smra ba'i dbang phyug kun mkhyen bzod chen par// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' legs grub zhabs// skad gnyis smra ba she'u lo tsā ba// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog legs rdo rje la// gsol ba= /sems dpa' chen po mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang*// rigs kun bdag po mkhyen rab byams pa'i dpal// mgon des rjes bzung rmor chen rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba= /skyabs gnas kun 'dus rigs brgya'i khyab bdag che// ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas zhabs// gang des rjes bzung blo gsal phun tshogs la// gsol ba= /skyabs gnas kun 'dus ngag dbang kun mkhyen zhabs// rgyal ba gnyis pa gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang*// gsang chen mnga' bdag 'gyur med mchog grub la// gsol ba= /karma gu ṇa

'di nas tshig rkang gnyis klu ming pas so// karma pra bhu ti// dus gsum rgyal ba kun 'dus ya sha'i mtshan// 'di nas rkang pa gsum maṅgās so// gdams pa'i gter mdzod ngag dbang klu sgrub la// gsol ba= /rgyal kun 'dus zhal mkhyen brtse'i dbang po sogs// smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsi stsol mkhas pa// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba= /sngon 'gro mi rtag dran pas rgyud sbyangs te// rang sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'tsher// drin can bla ma'i thugs kar rgyangs kyis 'phos// thog med mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis rlobs// ces pa 'di bya bral ba lhun grub kyis rang gi bsam gtan khang bur sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'pho ba'i gdams pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru/ gshin po'i don du 'pho ba'i man ngag bstan pa ni/ 'o/ 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa khyod nyon cig sems can thams cad la skye rga na 'chi'i chu bo chen po bzhi yod pa las/ da lan khyod 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa yin/ de la sdig po che btsan thabs su sangs rgyas par byed pa'i thabs 'pho ba'i gdams pa nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro shes rgyud kyi sdig sgrib rnams bshags pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin du bgyis/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bcom ldan 'das shākya'i rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can la sangs rgyas dkar po bdun byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can gyis bskor ba/ shar du sngon po bdun g.yas sa gnon g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor ser po bdun g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ nub tu dmar po bdun mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ byang du ljang gu bdun g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/

thams cad kyang mtshan dpes spras pa na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin gyi phung po chen po gtibs pa ltar bzhugs pa ni rten gyi stobs/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod nas sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod sems drag po byed pa ni rnam pa sun 'byin pa'i stobs/ phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyid snyam pa ni gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs/ de ltar bgyis pa'i 'dag nges snyam pa ni nyams pa sor chud pa'i stobs te/ stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas bshags par bgyi'o snyam pa'i lus gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma tsam du sprul nas phyag 'tshal bar mos pa'i sgo nas ltung ba bshags pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de nas ltung bshags gsungs/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo khyod 'pho ba'i dngos gzhi nyams su len pa ni/ sa chu la thim pas lus kyi yan lag rnams lci/ chu me la thim pas kha sna rnams skam/ me rlung la thim pas mig gyen la ldog rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pas phyi dbugs chad/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim pa'i dus su dngos grub len pa'i dus yin pa'i dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ngo bo khyod rang gang mos kyi bla ma rnams seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang sku mdog iṇ+ḍa ni la'i mdog ltar sngo ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad lcang lo'i tshul du 'phyang ba/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ mtshan dpes spras pa zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs sangs rgyas/ gsung dam chos/ sku dge 'dun/

yon tan nor lha/ phrin las chos skyong ste skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos nas gus 'dud rtse gcig tu mdzod/ khyod rang gi lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar du rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba lcag 'bring po tsam chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba/ pad+ma'i bsnal ma bzhin du srab pa/ rgya skyegs kyi khu ba ltar dmar ba ste/ chos bzhi ldan gyi spyi gtsug tu thong phug kha yer du yod par mos/ de'i nang du pha las thob pa'i dkar cha zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang ma las thob pa'i dmar cha nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma kha bshags tsam gyi steng na khyod rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu sran rdog 'bring po tsam dkar la 'tsher ba zhig rlung gis spar spar yod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nged kyis phaṭaḥbarjod pa'i tshe khyod rang gi sems kyi gong bu de dbu ma'i nang nas gyen du mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du song*/ bla ma'i thugs kar thim pas bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du gyur nas bde ba can du byon pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ༈ /rje sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// thugs mkhyen brtse'i yon tan lhun gyis grub// khyed ci mdzad dpag med 'gro ba'i mgon// sprang bdag la thugs rjes gzigs su gsol// rang mos pa'i bla ma rin po che// de mdun gyi nam mkhar yang yang sgoms// yid rtse gcig 'dun pa'i gsol ba thob// lus skyil krung tsog bu gang bde 'am// de ma grub gzhog g.yas 'og tu chug /gnas lte ba nas bzung spyi gtsug bar// rtsa dbu ma khong stong sba smyug tsam// steng spyi gtsug dkar khung thal le ba// sgo ma 'gags thal le yod pa la// sems 'od kyi gong bu dkar la 'gril// tshad sran rdog tsam zhig snying gar sgoms// de sog sbugs yungs dkar phu btab bzhin// de the tshom med par rgyang ste thon// de bla ma'i thugs kar thim du chug /dus da nas byang chub ma thob bar// ma drin can bde ba'i smon lam 'debs// de nas dmigs pa dang bcas/

phaṭaḥbarjod cing mnyam par bzhag lan gsum sogs ma theb bar du skyar la bsngo ba smon lam gyis rgyas 'debs/ yang rang nyid sbyangs pa'i tshe dmigs pa shin tu gsal bar bsgom gsol 'debs kyi 'jug tu phaṭa byas tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig la sogs brjod/ thun re la nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam skyar la/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe bla ma rang gi spyi gtsug nas byon snying gar bzhugs/ rang gi spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rjes bkag par bsam/ dge ba 'di yi skye bo kun// sogs kyis dge rtsa bsngo'o// de ltar thun bzhi sogs kyis zhag gsum mam bdun bar bsgom pas 'byongs pa'i rtags mgo za zhing na ba dang*/ spyi bo skrang pa dang*/ chu ser 'bab pa sogs rtags ma thon gyi bar du nyams su len/ rtags thon nas tshe sgrub bam mi nus na tshe gzungs brgya rtsa gsungs/ zhes pa 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa rong ston chen pos yum la brtse bas sgo nas gdams shing dmigs pa'i 'tshams sbyor khyer bde ba'i phyir tshig lhug 'di rnams mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po'i gsung rgyun bzhin gzhan phan 'ga' zhig gis bskul ngor shākya'i btsun pa mkhyen rab byams pas shrī nā len+d+ra rnam par rgyal ba'i chos grwar sbyar ba'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
